|errata_history=This is the original printed text. The later errata version is [[Shadows Of The Empire (Virtual Block 7) (Errata)]] (PC-E1, the current text). The Virtual Block 7.4 release-sheet slip and the Players Committee card image print this text. No published image shows the errata text; [[Shadows Of The Empire (Virtual Block 7) (Errata)]] uses a CardMaker recreation ([[:File:VB7-05-Shadows_Of_The_Empire-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]]).
* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 7.4 release sheet (official text as of 16 December 2011): “Deploy on Agents Of Black Sun. Mistryl are lost. Once per game, may ▲ Secret Plans. May use 3 Force to ▼ Imperial Square, and once per turn, if Emperor Palpatine there, may draw a card from Force Pile (and if you occupy three battlegrounds, opponent loses 1 Force). [Immune to Alter]”.<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock7_4">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_4.pdf Virtual Block 7.4 release sheet] ("Official text as of 16 December 2011"). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022223114/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_4.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Dark Side, p. 30) prints this text again. That copy is a stale reprint, not a new version, because the PC website card list already showed the later text of [[Shadows Of The Empire (Virtual Block 7) (Errata)]] (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Shadows Of The Empire (Virtual Block 7) (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 December 2012) changed “Once per game, may” to “Once per game may” and “and once per turn, if Emperor Palpatine there,” to “and while Emperor Palpatine there, once per turn,” (the card list writes the ▲ and ▼ icons out in words): “Deploy on Agents Of Black Sun. Mistryl are lost. Once per game may ▲ Secret Plans. May use 3 Force to ▼ Imperial Square, and while Emperor Palpatine there, once per turn, may draw a card from Force Pile (and if you occupy three battlegrounds, opponent loses 1 Force). [Immune to Alter]”.<ref name="cl-1274_8-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock7Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-07-21] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205229/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-12-11] (Internet Archive)</ref>
